description: A one-time $1,500 award for an active-duty member of the U.S. Armed Forces pursuing a STEM major.
eligibility_text: Must be an active-duty member of the U.S. Armed Forces. Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident. Must be enrolled in an accredited community college or four-year college/university. Minimum 2.8 unweighted GPA and in good academic standing. Must be pursuing a STEM-related major aligned with the mission of AFCEA. The page states no class year and no gender requirement.
notes: Split out of the retired 'afcea-stem-scholarship' umbrella on 2026-09-19. The umbrella averaged 13 named awards into eligibility true of none of them. Requires the applicant's own active-duty service; recorded on the military_family axis because that is the only service-connection axis Stage 1 filters on. This is the $1,500 bottom of the retired umbrella's range and it is a hard no for a civilian undergraduate. Page status on 2026-09-19: 'Applications closed!'. The page publishes no application deadline; 'no later than May 1, 2026' is the mailed-documents date for the closed cycle, recorded as cycle.deadline_month 5.
